verdict.rationale: Docs show Rippling can build custom security policies based on device attributes (rippling-it-docs-6) and revoke access based on risk signals/company policy (rippling-it-docs-1, rippling-it-docs-31), implying some device-attribute-gated access control. However, there is no explicit documentation that managed/encrypted/screen-locked posture is specifically checked as a pre-condition in an auth policy before an app session is granted (no conditional-access flow described). Missing for 10: explicit encryption/screen-lock/managed checks tied to real-time auth-time gating, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of this specific enforcement flow.
